rules.title: Sikkim: Protected Area Permit for border areas
rules.detail: Needed for Tsomgo, Nathu La, Zuluk to Kupup, Lachen, Lachung, Thangu and Gurudongmar. Issued by the Permit Cell in Gangtok and district tourism offices. The page gives no fee amounts.
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

rules.title: Sikkim: motorcycle must be registered to the rider
rules.detail: The official page allows only self-registered, self-ridden motorcycles in permit areas. Apply one day ahead with the bank fee receipt. Two-wheeler permits run up to seven days.
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

rules.title: Sikkim: rented motorcycles apply through a registered operator
rules.detail: A motorcycle hired inside Sikkim gets its permit through a government-registered local tour operator, not directly by the rider.
rules.applies_to: Riders on motorcycles rented in Sikkim
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

rules.title: Sikkim: proposed bar on two-wheelers in permit areas
rules.detail: Proposal discussed on 19 August 2026 would bar two-wheelers and vehicles registered outside Sikkim from permit areas. It needs Cabinet approval. No decision found as of 28 September 2026.
rules.applies_to: All two-wheelers; all vehicles registered outside Sikkim

rules.title: North Sikkim: permits stop when the road fails
rules.detail: Lachen and Gurudongmar permits stopped after the October 2023 flood and resumed in 2026. They can be suspended at short notice after landslides.
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim and Mangan district administration

rules.detail: A blog updated in August 2026 says one-night permits are no longer issued and foreign citizens are not allowed to the lake. No official order found.

rules.title: Sikkim: 150cc minimum claimed for permit areas
rules.detail: Blogs say motorcycles under 150cc are refused permits for North Sikkim, Nathu La and Zuluk. The official page does not mention engine size; no order found.

rules.title: Sikkim: Aadhaar not accepted as proof of nationality
rules.detail: The official tourism page says an Aadhaar card is not accepted as proof of citizenship or nationality when applying for permits.
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

rules.title: Sikkim: papers riders are asked for
rules.detail: A travel site lists photo identity, driving licence, registration, insurance and pollution certificates, plus photographs, in duplicate. No official list found.

rules.title: Sikkim: foreign citizens need a Restricted Area Permit
rules.detail: Valid 30 days, extendable by 30 in Gangtok. Protected areas need a group routed through a registered operator. Bhutanese citizens are exempt.
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

source.title: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department: general information

rules.title: Sikkim: foreign riders need an International Driving Licence
rules.detail: Stated on the official tourism page. A foreigner's two-wheeler pass covers one day to Tsomgo, or up to five days in North Sikkim.
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

source.title: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department: general information

gaps: No report found of a Cabinet decision on the 19 August 2026 two-wheeler proposal: one web search and the Sikkim front pages of two news sites were checked on 28 September 2026.
The news report on permits resuming names only 'Friday'; it is dated Friday 11 September 2026, so that date is recorded.
Blog and news disagree on 2026: the blog records permits resuming on 9 March and stopping around June; the news report says no Lachen permits were issued until September.
Neither source says whether motorcycles were included when permits resumed in 2026.
Altitude of Gurudongmar Lake is converted from the district website's 17,800 feet; Wikipedia gives 16,910 feet (5,154 metres) from terrain maps.
Highway number from Gangtok to Chungthang not sourced.
No official source for the 150cc minimum, the two-night minimum, or the documents list.
The vehicle pass portal vehiclepass.sikkim.gov.in could not be opened (certificate error).
Road status lines on the Mangan district website carry no dates of their own; only the site's last-updated date (24 September 2026) is known.
No official acclimatisation advisory found for Gurudongmar.
Fee amounts are not on the official page and are left out.
